title: Safety-check card file (public/data/safety/cards.json)
description: Written by scripts/safety/build_cards.py. Evals are White point of view ({cp} or {mate}); every `win` is the trainee's win% 0-100 on Lichess's retro scale (cp clamped to +-1000, mate N counted as (21 - min(10, |N|)) * 100 cp). Verdict order for a move the trainee makes: (1) own card and the move is human.uci: fail, 'That was the game move'; (2) held or quiet card with `moves`: the move's entry passes when retroAccept(side, entry.eval, top[0].eval) or entry.safe (the safety rule: under 15 points lost, no mate against him, under 2 points of material given away along its settled line); (3) the move is in top: pass when retroAccept(side, entry.eval, top[0].eval), i.e. entry.win > top[0].win - 4; (4) the move is human.uci (held or quiet card): human.passes; (5) topComplete: fail; (6) otherwise ask the browser engine (Lichess readiness rule) and compare with top[0].

generatedAt.description: Start time of the newest game included (not the wall clock, so rebuilds are byte-identical).

nodes.description: Nodes for the MultiPV search of each card and for the game move when it is not in top.

measurementNodes.description: The pre-registered measurement setting used to pick the positions (judgements, threat test).

extendNodes.description: Nodes per move when a stored line is lengthened by sequential searches.

moveEntry.description: One legal move of a held or quiet card, searched on its own (root_moves) at the card setting. Within 4 points of top[0]: only uci and eval. Otherwise also line, gain and safe.

line.description: The move's own line, starting with the move, its first 6 plies carried on until no exchange is left open.

gain.description: Points of material he gives away along line (facts.claim_gain: the smaller of the median rule and the plain count at the end); null when the line still ends mid-exchange.

safe.description: Under 15 points lost against top[0] (retro scale), no mate against him, and gain under 2 (or null).

win.description: 2 decimals, or more on a card where 2 would put a move on the other side of the 4-point line than its eval does.

pv.description: Engine line starting with this move, up to 6 plies: pv[1..] is the refutation to play on the board.

oneOf.description: He threatens {reply}, winning your {wins.piece} on {wins.square} / He threatens mate in {mateIn}, starting with {reply} / He threatens {reply}, winning material ({lineSan[0..2]}). Not 'His move ... threatens': on 5 of 74 threats naming a piece (2026-10-16) the piece could already be taken before his last move. The line starts from the position with the trainee to move but passing.
After {move}, he can play {reply} and win your {wins.piece} on {wins.square} / and mate in {mateIn} / and win material ({lineSan[1..3]}). The line starts with the game move.
His move left his {piece} on {square} unprotected: the best move takes it and the line nets {gain} points.

Nothing was threatened here. (Passing would have cost him under 5 points.) Since 2026-10-17 quiet and held cards accept any safe move (moves[].safe), but the sentence stays as it is: 'safe' also needs the move to lose under 15 points, which 'keeps your pieces protected' does not say.

id.description: kind:gameId:ply of his move (ply counted from 1).

cls.description: Own cards: the my-games category (the last two only when he faced a concrete threat).

fenBefore.description: Position BEFORE the opponent's last move.

facingThreat.description: The pre-registered threat test: passing would cost 15+ win% points and 2+ points of material or a mate.

nothingToWin.description: Facing a threat, the best move is not a capture winning 2+ (static exchange), the best line wins nothing, no mate, and the best move leaves him at 65% or less.

wasWinning.description: His win% before the move was 75 or more (measurement eval, no clamp).

top.description: The moves a MultiPV 5 search picks, each then searched on its own at the same node count; sorted by win, best first.

topComplete.description: True exactly when the last top entry fails the 4-point test, so any move outside top fails at once.

moves.description: Held and quiet cards only: every legal move, sorted by uci (the safety rule decides them all from stored data).

passes.description: Always false on own cards (as on Lichess); otherwise the 4-point test against top[0] or the safety rule (the game move's moves entry).

judgment.description: The pre-registered replication of Lichess's game-page label.

lichessJudgment.description: Lichess's own label, when Lichess analysed the game.

drop.description: Win% points the game move lost by the measurement evals (no clamp).

loss.description: Win% points he would lose by passing (null-move test, measurement setting).

line.description: The opponent's best line if he passed, from the position after the pass.

clockMs.description: His clock when the position arose (before thinking).
